description:
# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.14

Source check: opi-q5k.14 (regression-regional-indicator-width.test.ts audit)

## Gaps

Upstream tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/regression-regional-indicator-width.test.ts covers streaming-drift prevention for wide graphemes. Our wrap_ansi_test.exs covers only the first (🇨=2, 🇨🇳=2) case.

## Work — add to apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi_test.exs

1. Extend "treats isolated regional indicators as width 2" (or add a new test):
   - `assert WrapAnsi.visible_width("      - 🇨") == 10`

2. Add "wraps intermediate partial-flag list line before overflow":
   - `wrapped = WrapAnsi.wrap("      - 🇨", 9)`
   - `assert length(wrapped) == 2`
   - `assert WrapAnsi.visible_width(Enum.at(wrapped, 0)) == 7`
   - `assert WrapAnsi.visible_width(Enum.at(wrapped, 1)) == 2`

3. Add "treats all regional-indicator singleton graphemes as width 2":
   - For each codepoint in 0x1F1E6..0x1F1FF, assert `WrapAnsi.visible_width(<< cp :: utf8 >>) == 2`.

4. Add "keeps full flag pairs at width 2":
   - For each of ["🇯🇵", "🇺🇸", "🇬🇧", "🇨🇳", "🇩🇪", "🇫🇷"], assert width 2.

5. Add "keeps common streaming emoji intermediates at stable width":
   - For each of ["👍", "👍🏻", "✅", "⚡", "⚡️", "👨", "👨‍💻", "🏳️‍🌈"], assert width 2.

If any of these fail, do NOT relax the assertion — the upstream invariant exists to prevent streaming render drift. Instead, fix `WrapAnsi.visible_width` (likely in apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/wrap_ansi.ex) to match the invariant, and document the fix.

## Re-comparison (required)

After the tests land, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/regression-regional-indicator-width.test.ts and confirm every upstream assertion has an Elixir equivalent. Post a final comment here with the re-comparison before closing.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).

comments.text: Done. 5 new tests in wrap_ansi_test.exs covering all 5 upstream regression-regional-indicator-width.test.ts behaviors. Re-comparison: all upstream it(...) blocks have Elixir equivalents.
